notes.title: First post-launch patch:
notes.content:
[list]
  [*] Inventory and status message are now smaller so they always fit on screen.
  [*] Max inventory increased 10 -> 12.
  [*] Fixed menu display glitch when switching levels.
  [*] Now has crash reporting. 
[/list]
